column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the way of your commandments I run” is rendered “I will run the course of Your commandments.”
Close to the Hebrew; עֵקֶב (“to the end, as reward”) is rendered “to the end.”
Close to the Hebrew; אֶל־ בָּצַע (“to unjust gain”) is rendered “to covetousness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “which is for fear of you” is rendered “Who is devoted to fearing You.”
Close to the Hebrew; “acts of covenant loyalty” is rendered “mercies.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a word of faithfulness” is rendered “the word of truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the broad place” is rendered “at liberty.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the house of my sojournings” is rendered “the house of my pilgrimage.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I have entreated your face” is rendered “I entreated Your favor.”
